models.name: Particle heat transfer (1-D spherical conduction, finite volume)
models.source: Bird, Stewart & Lightfoot (2002); Incropera et al. (2011); Carslaw & Jaeger (1959) analytical sphere verification; Di Blasi (2003) particle pyrolysis modelling precedent.
models.status: Verified (solves its equations correctly: <0.1% vs analytical). Not validated against measured particle temperatures; property values and h are assumptions; single particle, no bed effects.

models.name: One-step global devolatilisation kinetics
models.source: Di Blasi, C. and Branca, C. (2001). Kinetics of primary product formation from wood pyrolysis. Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 40(23), 5547-5556. DOI: 10.1021/ie000997e.
models.status: Single global first-order devolatilisation step. Beech-wood parameters fitted over 573–708 K; other feedstocks and temperatures outside this range are extrapolations. Used for conversion time only, not product yields.
